title: vaccinium hirtum var. smallii
intro: Vaccinium hirtum var. smallii, commonly known as Small's blueberry, is a plant species of the heath family (Ericaceae) and is native to North America. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium hirtum var. smallii include its ability to reduce oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
